notes: CHK-010 counters were not given, so I assumed them. WA counts accepted writes (i_wr_en && !o_full) on i_clk_wr. RA counts accepted reads (i_rd_en && !o_empty) on i_clk_rd. Both counters clear on their domain reset and while o_sw_rst_busy is 1. OCC_R is registered at each read edge as WA, taken before that edge so a coincident write edge isn't counted, minus RA including an accept at that edge. It is checked at the next read edge, when busy is 0 at both edges. CHK-005 compares the sampled o_underflow against a registered (i_rd_en && o_empty) from the previous edge. It was not compiled or run in Verilator.
